skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand key terms related to business intelligence, big data, data warehouses, data mining, and data visualization.
Explain business intelligence models, performance management processes, revenue generation processes, and large data mining system operation processes.
Deploy stages of the business intelligence system development process, including data warehouse deployment, data mining tools, and data visualization tools.
Understand and use modeling tools, data warehouse creation, data mining, and data visualization tools for smart business operations.
Deploy, implement, and analyze the strengths and weaknesses of business intelligence systems, evaluating challenges and difficulties.
Have skills in analyzing, forecasting, and representing data using various visualization methods in digital economic environments.
Develop skills in analysis, planning, digital transformation, and smart business development.
Have the ability to self-study, read materials, and think about business intelligence when approaching and solving business problems.
Be able to work independently or actively, positively, and effectively in group activities.
Have organizational abilities for group activities.
Have social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of management information systems.
